blurb: The Nashville Tour is a special 3-hour shopping tour by golf cart throughout Music City. This tour will hit up some of Nashville’s buzz worthy boutiques, while dropping in for some sips at some of the best watering holes in town. No cowboy boots? No problem! Our tour guides are ready to put you face-to-face with our top of the line boot stores. Plenty of photo ops available as your tour guide drives you by some of the hottest murals Nashville has to offer.
